<subject>Component Orders 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Supplier Quality Coordinator for Mark Thompson this year. I understand you managed supplier contracts for your division last year. I have not yet received confirmation on who is handling supplier contracts for your division this year. Could you please reply to this email and let me know if you are the contract manager for your division this year? If you are not, could you kindly provide the name of the current contract manager along with the division code(s) in your response? I have already sent three emails to contract managers today and need to update your division’s contact details as soon as possible. Thanks very much for your assistance!
</body>
